Scene:
古代时候，人不知道他们能吃什么植物，常常一吃就死。但是不知道为什么，没有办法。所以有一天，神农出去试一试很多种植物，告诉人什么植物是安全什么是危险。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 古代时候，人不知道他们能吃什么植物：古代的时候，人们
- 所以有一天，神农出去试一试很多种植物：better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears
- 告诉人什么植物是安全什么是危险：是安全的，是危险的
- 发现有的植物对身体非常好，特别是茶，让肚子感觉又暖和又清楚：add他in the beginning; delete 感觉，又暖和又舒服

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: 他们能吃：能吃，The possessive pronoun is redundant because the people who can eat the plants are already the subject. [rule: redundancy_delete]
Run 2: 他们能吃什么植物：能吃什么植物，delete the redundant pronoun because the people who may eat the plants are already the subject of the sentence. [rule: redundancy_delete]
Run 3: 他们能吃什么植物：什么植物能吃，After the people have been named, the repeated subject is unnecessary in this embedded question. [rule: redundancy_delete]

output.reason: All runs identify the redundant 他们 and correctly remove it, with Run 3 using an equivalent word order.
